card.name: Words leading into dialysis or renal replacement
card.fires_on: The word just before "dialysis" or "replacement therapy" when a patient's kidney treatment is described, such as "on", "requiring", "using", "hem" (hemodialysis) or "renal".

modes.label: Linking word before dialysis
modes.description: A small word such as on, requiring or using that introduces a patient receiving dialysis.

modes.label: Start of a kidney-treatment term
modes.description: Renal, kidney or hem that opens a term such as renal dialysis, hemodialysis or renal replacement therapy.
modes.example: Renal Impairment, including<< hem>>odialysis: No dosage adjustment of Z

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated words.
card.plain: It lights up on the words that lead into dialysis or kidney replacement therapy in dosing text.
